recognize_zh: 高倍切片中大片粉紅色無定形、帶細纖維紋路的基質，只有一小群小而圓、深染核的造血細胞與沿微血管排列的紅血球，旁邊是萎縮的小脂肪空泡，呈現骨髓膠狀轉化。
features: Abundant pale eosinophilic, amorphous extracellular matrix with delicate fibrillar texture
Small cluster of residual hematopoietic cells with small round, densely hyperchromatic nuclei (likely erythroid precursors/lymphocytes)
Capillaries containing red cells coursing through the matrix
Small clear vacuoles representing atrophic fat cells
Occasional isolated stromal/spindle cells within the matrix
describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows extensive pale eosinophilic amorphous extracellular material with a delicate fibrillar texture. A small cluster of residual hematopoietic cells with small round hyperchromatic nuclei is present, along with capillaries containing red cells and scattered small atrophic fat vacuoles. No abnormal infiltrate is seen. Findings are consistent with gelatinous transformation of the marrow.

ddx.vs: Amyloid shows Congo red positivity with apple-green birefringence and is more glassy, while this matrix is Alcian blue positive.
Edema and hemorrhage lack the fibrillar mucoid ground substance and adipocyte atrophy.
Necrotic cells show loss of nuclear detail with eosinophilic debris, unlike these intact hyperchromatic nuclei.
